# 2026-10-29: #13863 (#13061) at 84b2ea38, from a local profile-costs run. A handler or a callback
# that a program passes by name is now a direct call. closure_call.ir is 35% to 52% lower, and
# http_hello is 5% to 34% smaller. The map_string programs grow: each map operation has a clone per key kind.
